title: prompt
description: The prompt record for one plate (prompts/NNNN.json, or the cover/portrait pseudo-plates). Holds the derived illustration prompt, any human edit, and the fully-assembled strings plus render provenance (DESIGN §4.3, §10).

page_id.description: Plate id: a zero-padded 4-digit page id, or a pseudo-plate id 'cover' or 'portrait-{slug}' (DESIGN §10).

derived.description: The 'illustration-prompt' transform output stored verbatim (DESIGN §4.3). Opaque — its internal shape (including fields like 'prompt' and 'avoid') is owned by text-transform-service, so it is not constrained here.

edited_prompt.description: Human-edited subject prompt from the review gate, or null if unedited (DESIGN §11.1).

final_subject_prompt.description: The subject prompt actually used: edited_prompt if set, else derived.prompt (DESIGN §4.3).

wrapped_prompt.description: The full style-wrapped string sent to imagegen: style.prefix + final_subject_prompt + style.suffix (DESIGN §10). Present after render; absent for draft prompts.

negative_prompt.description: The negative prompt sent to imagegen: style.negative joined with derived.avoid (DESIGN §10). Present after render; absent for draft prompts.

render.description: Render provenance for this plate. Absent until the plate has been rendered (P7).

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the (latest) render.

params_echo.description: The render parameters echoed back by the imagegen service (seed, size, steps, etc.). Opaque — shape owned by the imagegen service, not constrained here.

attempts.description: Number of render attempts made for this plate.
